title: State Commission or National Commission must hear appeal expeditiously
description: The Commission must hear the appeal as expeditiously as possible and endeavour to dispose of it within 90 days

content.what: must hear appeal expeditiously and endeavour to dispose of it within 90 days
conditions: the reasons for grant of adjournment have been recorded in writing
limitations: no adjournment shall ordinarily be granted
the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall make such orders as to the costs occasioned by the adjournment, as may be specified by regulations
the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall record in writing the reasons for the same at the time of disposing of the said appeal
